component.name: GPUIdium
component.summary: A minimal workspace for arbitrary websites

description.p: GPUIdium keeps your web apps in a narrow icon sidebar. Paste an address and it becomes a persistent entry with its own isolated browser profile, so two entries for the same site can be signed in as different users.

ul.li: Every app has its own cookies, storage and cache, kept separate from all others
No recipe catalog, no account, no telemetry
Page favicons in the sidebar, keyboard-first navigation, drag to reorder
Optional, off by default: unload idle apps, page notifications

description.p: The page content is rendered by the system's WebKitGTK. On Linux, GPUIdium currently runs on X11 or XWayland.

screenshot.caption: An app with its page favicon in the icon sidebar
Managing apps, settings and saved data

description.p: Bug fix: on macOS, page dialogs from alert(), confirm() and prompt() now appear. No changes for Linux.
Unread badges on the sidebar icons, page notifications switchable per app (on by default), spell checking with several dictionaries at once.
No changes for Linux (macOS app bundle only).
Page zoom (Ctrl + plus, minus, 0), Ctrl+K and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts are left to web apps.
First release for Linux (X11 and XWayland).
